transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in to see me?
For about a week now, I've been feeling completely emotionally numb, like my mind is just totally empty. Even when good things happen, I can't seem to feel any happiness or joy at all.
Have you been feeling this way most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks, or has it mainly been tied to a recent stressful event?
No, it hasn't been two weeks yet—it's only been about a week, but it felt like a really sudden shift. I've been feeling this empty almost constantly since it started, and I'm just so tired.
Did this start after a specific stressful event or major life change, such as a breakup, loss, work problem, or conflict?
I'm not really sure if there was a specific event that triggered this. Nothing major comes to mind, and it feels like this numbness just started out of nowhere.
Besides feeling numb and unable to feel joy, have you also been feeling down, hopeless, or depressed most of the day?

I wouldn't say I feel down or hopeless, but my mind just feels completely empty and devoid of any positive emotions. Instead, I've been feeling incredibly irritable and angry, like my nerves are always on edge. It's more of a numb, frustrated feeling than being depressed.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy, or is it mainly the numbness and irritability?

Yes, it's really both. I've completely lost interest because I can't feel any happiness or satisfaction even when doing things I used to enjoy. At the same time, I just feel totally numb inside and constantly irritable or on edge.
Have you also had changes in sleep, appetite, energy, or concentration since this started?
I haven't really noticed any major changes in my sleep or appetite since this started. My energy levels and concentration seem pretty much the same as usual, too.
Did this start after a specific stressful event or major life change, such as a breakup, loss, work problem, or conflict?
Like I mentioned, I really can't pinpoint a specific major life change or stressful event that started all of this. It just seemed to build up over the past week out of nowhere.
Did this start after a specific stressful event or major life change, such as a breakup, loss, work problem, or conflict?

I really can't recall or identify any specific stressful event or major life change that might have triggered this. Nothing like a breakup, loss, or work issue happened, and these feelings just started occurring out of nowhere about a week ago. It just came on very suddenly.
Did this start after a specific stressful event or major life change, such as a breakup, loss, work problem, or conflict?

As I mentioned, I really can't think of any specific stressful event or major change that caused this. There hasn't been any breakup, loss, or conflict, and these feelings just started happening out of nowhere about a week ago.
Besides feeling numb and unable to feel joy, have you also been feeling down, hopeless, or depressed most of the day?
No, I don't really feel sad, down, or hopeless. Instead, my mind just feels completely empty and numb, as if I am unable to feel any emotions at all.
